concept.title: Content organization
concept.abstract: This chapter explains how DITA content is organized using independent topic files, maps, and folder structures to support modular authoring, content reuse, and scalable documentation management. It covers strategies for flat and nested folder organization, file naming conventions, topic classification, reusable content storage, and project structuring practices that improve maintainability, findability, version control, and publishing efficiency. The chapter provides practical guidelines for organizing documentation projects of varying sizes while maintaining consistency and supporting automation.
